archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-05.5 Approve and Register Statistical Products
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
In step 5, each statistical product undergoes a formal review and approval process. Quality reviewers, domain experts, and governance bodies check that all data, methods, and interpretations meet internal standards and external obligations.
Once approved, the product is registered as an official statistical artefact. It is documented with detailed metadata — including data sources, methodology, quality indicators, and publication details.
This versioned and registered product becomes the official output of the organization, ready for dissemination through appropriate channels.
Value created: Verified, traceable, and approved statistical products ready for publication and reuse.
